mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_transaction( account_id, transacted_at, inout_type, amount, balance_after, description, category_id, memo ) VALUES( #{accountId}, #{transactedAt}, #{inoutType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT transaction_id, account_id, transacted_at, inout_type, amount, balance_after, description, category_id, memo, created_at FROM bank_transaction WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY transacted_at DESC, transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{cri.pageSize} OFFSET #{cri.offset}

SELECT transaction_id, account_id, transacted_at, inout_type, amount, balance_after, description, category_id, memo, created_at FROM bank_transaction WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY transaction_at DESC, transaction_id DESC

SELECT transaction_id, account_id, transacted_at, inout_type, amount, balance_after, description, category_id, memo, created_at FROM bank_transaction WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND DATE(transacted_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY transacted_at DESC, transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{cri.pageSize} OFFSET #{cri.offset}
